periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 40-degree downward-lateral orientation relative to the sagittal plane of the head.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering towards the muzzle, creating a teardrop-shaped inferior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shape profile with a relatively flat posterior edge.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, estimated at approximately 35% of the visible anterior-to-posterior torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Moderate gap, approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semi-circular curvature with no visible flattening or notches.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant chromatic variance between the bright white fur on the neck/shoulders and the distinct yellowish/tan discoloration on the posterior hindquarters.
